purpose: Re-screen candidate families while Alpha 015's point-in-time universe is accumulating, without inspecting any project return data or opening Experiment 0016.

search_record.source_priority: original academic papers and publisher-hosted research

candidates.name: OPEN_INTEREST_STATE_OR_LIQUIDATION_ALPHA
candidates.reason: A tick-level multi-exchange study finds systematic reconciliation failures between reported perpetual-swap open interest and traded volume, including Binance. Public OI can remain a data-quality diagnostic only; it is not accepted as a return-prediction feature until an independent, source-bound consistency protocol passes.
candidates.retain: Use OI discrepancies to veto or downgrade risk telemetry, never to create a directional trade signal.

candidates.name: COPULA_COINTEGRATION_PAIRS_USDTM
candidates.reason: A 2026 peer-reviewed Binance USDT perpetual study on ten contracts reports that its market-neutral copula pairs strategies are negative after its baseline costs and funding. Testing parameter variants after Alpha 002's mean-reversion failure would be overlapping post-hoc optimization, not an independent alpha.
candidates.retain: The paper is retained as a cost-stress benchmark and failure reference only.

candidates.name: PERPETUAL_SPOT_FUNDAMENTAL_VALUE_ARBITRAGE
candidates.reason: The theoretical and empirical perpetual-futures framework requires a spot-plus-perpetual random-maturity arbitrage book. That is a different capital, venue, custody, and liquidation-risk system from the requested Binance USDT-M futures-only portfolio, and the apparent arbitrage is explicitly not riskless under margin and transaction costs.
candidates.retain: Its warning that random-maturity arbitrage can liquidate before convergence is incorporated as a portfolio risk principle, not an alpha claim.

selection_rationale: No reviewed family clears independence, source integrity, execution feasibility, and cost-aware evidence thresholds. Alpha 015 remains the only preregistration-ready candidate once its 180-day universe condition is met.
guard: This screening is not return evidence, does not authorize data acquisition, and does not alter live-order authorization.
